summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MicroXisto EasyX PWA after code restoration from GitHub and feature merge. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: navigation tabs, home page button grid, concorre_microxisto dropdown, admin dashboard with filters and summary boxes, inline editing, Excel export.

minor.issue: API requires all fields for update (not partial update). This is by design but could be improved for better UX.

critical_code_review_comments: Service Worker uses network-first strategy as expected (sw.js line 142-168)
MICROXISTO_PRODUCTS constant has 17 products matching the dropdown options
Admin dashboard correctly shows filters (Empresa, Produto, Tipo de Venda, Estado) and summary boxes (Menor/Médio/Maior Valor)
Inline editing in admin table works correctly with Salvar/Cancel buttons
seed_data_creation: Test market studies created during testing were cleaned up. Existing data: 15 market studies in DB with various concorre_microxisto values (Active, MN-MAX, ZINMAX, Magnus, Guardian)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from the GitHub restoration and feature merge are working correctly. Key features verified: 1) Navigation tabs (Início, Tecnologias, Culturas, Planejamento, Comparativo, Estudo de Mercado, Admin) 2) Home page button grid (Planejamento, Culturas, Mercado, Tecnologias, Portfolio, Comparativo) 3) 'Concorre com qual produto MicroXisto?' dropdown in market study form with 17 products 4) 'Meus Registros' table shows 'Produto MX' column 5) Admin > 'Estudo Mercado' tab has Dashboard with filters, summary boxes, state breakdown 6) Admin records table has Editar/Excluir buttons for inline editing 7) 'Baixar Excel' button for export 8) Service Worker uses network-first strategy

navigation_tabs.details: All 7 tabs visible after login: Início, Tecnologias, Culturas, Planejamento, Comparativo, Estudo de Mercado, Admin

home_page_button_grid.details: 6 buttons visible: Planejamento, Culturas, Mercado, Tecnologias, Portfolio, Comparativo

concorre_microxisto_dropdown.details: Dropdown found with data-testid='market-concorre-select'. Contains 18 options (1 placeholder + 17 products): Magnus, Pullseed Ni, Pullseed G, Active, One-Max, Complex, MN-MAX, ZINMAX, S-MAX, Guardian, TRUCKER, CA-ULTRA, MG-ULTRA, Citro-X, Tek-F, Alvo, DTA

create_market_study_with_concorre_microx.details: POST /api/market-studies with concorre_microxisto field saves correctly. Field is optional.

meus_registros_table_column.details: 'Produto MX' column visible in 'Meus Registros' table showing MicroXisto products

admin_dashboard_filters.details: Admin > Estudo Mercado has filters: Empresa, Produto, Tipo de Venda, Estado with 'Aplicar Filtros' and 'Limpar' buttons

admin_dashboard_summary_boxes.details: Summary boxes show: Menor Valor (R$ 45.00), Valor Médio (R$ 130.73), Maior Valor (R$ 320.00)

admin_dashboard_state_breakdown.details: State breakdown shows: SP, PR, MG, GO, MT, RS, MS with their respective stats

admin_records_table.details: Records table shows 15 records with columns: Cultura, Empresa, Produto, Valor, Dose, R$/ha, Venda, Estado, Produto MX, Ações

admin_inline_editing.details: Clicking 'Editar' converts row to editable inputs with 'Salvar' and 'X' (cancel) buttons. 4 input fields appear in editing mode.

admin_baixar_excel.details: 'Baixar Excel' button (data-testid='export-market-btn') present. GET /api/admin/market-studies/export returns Excel file.

service_worker_network_first.details: Service Worker (sw.js) uses network-first strategy for navigation and APIs. Version: 3.5.0

backend_admin_endpoints.details: All admin endpoints working: GET /api/admin/market-studies/all, PUT /api/admin/market-studies/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/market-studies/{id}, GET /api/admin/market-studies/dashboard-by-microxisto
